home.feature.selfhosted.description.message: One Docker container and one SQLite file on your machine. No central server, no account, no telemetry.

home.feature.watch.description.message: A product page (restock, out of stock, preorder) or a listing page, like the Fanatec refurbished page, to spot every new item.

home.feature.notify.description.message: Telegram today, email next, with several accounts per channel if you want.

home.feature.frequency.description.message: A default check frequency, which you can tune product by product.

home.feature.plugins.description.message: Every site and every notification channel is an isolated module written in TypeScript. You can add one without touching the core.

home.feature.updates.description.message: A banner tells you about each new version, and you can install it in one click from the interface.

home.tagline.message: Get notified as soon as a product is back in stock, or a new item shows up. Open source, self-hosted, in English and French.

home.install.description.message: On macOS or Linux, with Docker installed. The script asks a few questions, starts the app and shows you its address.

home.install.more.message: Windows, manual install with Docker Compose, picking a version: it's all in {link}.

home.meta.description.message: Back in stock ! watches product and listing pages and notifies you on Telegram as soon as a product is back in stock. Open source, self-hosted with Docker.
